# WhatsApp Checker API

> Check whether phone numbers are registered on WhatsApp with the NumberChecker asynchronous API.

Official landing page: https://numberchecker.ai/products/whatsapp-checker
Documentation: https://docs.numberchecker.ai/whatsapp-bulk-checker
API base: https://api.numberchecker.ai
Authentication: X-API-Key
Products: ws
Examples: Python, Node.js, Go, Java, C#, PHP, JavaScript, Shell
Pricing: https://numberchecker.ai/pricing

Workflow: multipart `POST /v1/tasks` with `file` and `task_type=ws`; poll multipart `POST /v1/gettasks` with `task_id`; download `result_url` only when `status=exported`. Input is 500–10,000,000 E.164 phone numbers, one per line. Export fields are `number` and `activated`. Server examples read `NUMBERCHECKER_API_KEY`.
